```python
from fractions import Fraction

def atom(predicate, *args):
    return (predicate,) + args

def opposite(a):
    p = a[0]
    return ((p[4:] if p.startswith("not_") else "not_" + p),) + a[1:]

animals = (
    "cobra", "dove", "songbird", "pelikan", "seahorse",
    "beetle", "wolf", "mannikin", "bulldog", "woodpecker",
    "cougar", "butterfly"
)

facts = {
    atom("has_drink", "cobra"),  # A smoothie is something to drink.
    atom("movie_year", "cobra", 1971),
    atom("in", "dove", "Istanbul"),
    atom("enjoys", "songbird", "pelikan"),
    atom("card_color", "songbird", "red"),
}

# A rectangular notebook may be rotated to fit the box.
w, h = Fraction(16), Fraction(19)
bw, bh = Fraction("21.6"), Fraction("18.2")
notebook_fits = (w <= bw and h <= bh) or (h <= bw and w <= bh)
if notebook_fits:
    facts.add(atom("notebook_fits", "dove"))

# Nixon resigned in 1974; a 1971 movie does not satisfy Rule 9.
if 1971 > 1974:
    facts.add(atom("movie_after_nixon_resigned", "cobra"))

rules = []

def add(name, premises, conclusion):
    rules.append((name, frozenset(premises), conclusion))

for x in animals:
    add("R1", [
        atom("enjoys", x, "seahorse"),
        atom("suspects", x, "beetle"),
    ], atom("not_suspects", x, "wolf"))
    add("R4", [atom("enjoys", x, "pelikan")],
        atom("photo", x, "mannikin"))
    add("R5", [atom("smiles", x, "bulldog")],
        atom("enjoys", x, "mannikin"))
    add("R8", [atom("photo", x, "cougar")],
        atom("not_enjoys", x, "seahorse"))
    add("R10", [atom("destroys_wall", x, "woodpecker")],
        atom("enjoys", "mannikin", "seahorse"))

add("R2", [atom("in", "dove", "France")],
    atom("smiles", "dove", "bulldog"))
add("R3", [atom("photo", "songbird", "mannikin")],
    atom("suspects", "mannikin", "beetle"))
add("R6", [atom("notebook_fits", "dove")],
    atom("smiles", "dove", "bulldog"))
add("R7", [atom("has_drink", "cobra")],
    atom("destroys_wall", "cobra", "woodpecker"))
add("R9", [atom("movie_after_nixon_resigned", "cobra")],
    atom("destroys_wall", "cobra", "woodpecker"))
add("R11", [
    atom("enjoys", "dove", "mannikin"),
    atom("smiles", "butterfly", "mannikin"),
], atom("suspects", "mannikin", "wolf"))

preferred = {("R11", "R1"), ("R8", "R10")}

# Exhaustive grounding above; now compute the prioritized rule closure.
# A preference defeats an opposing rule only when all premises of the
# preferred rule are established.
known = set(facts)
seen = set()
while True:
    state = frozenset(known)
    if state in seen:
        print("UNSUPPORTED: rule evaluation did not stabilize")
        print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
        break
    seen.add(state)

    applicable = [r for r in rules if r[1] <= known]
    new_known = set(facts)
    for name, premises, head in applicable:
        defeated = any(
            other_head == opposite(head)
            and (other_name, name) in preferred
            for other_name, _, other_head in applicable
        )
        if not defeated:
            new_known.add(head)

    if new_known == known:
        positive = atom("suspects", "mannikin", "wolf") in known
        negative = atom("not_suspects", "mannikin", "wolf") in known

        print("Notebook fits:", notebook_fits)
        print("Butterfly smiles at mannikin:",
              atom("smiles", "butterfly", "mannikin") in known)
        print("Positive conclusion derived:", positive)
        print("Negative conclusion derived:", negative)

        if positive and negative:
            print("UNSUPPORTED: conflicting conclusions")
            print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
        else:
            expected = (
                "proved" if positive else
                "disproved" if negative else
                "unknown"
            )
            submitted = "unknown"
            print("Expected result:", expected)
            print("Submitted result:", submitted)
            print("CHECK PASS" if expected == submitted else "CHECK FAIL")
        break
    known = new_known
```
